22544-a-world-is-born.title: A World Is Born
22544-a-world-is-born.creator: Leigh Brackett
22544-a-world-is-born.description: A book by Leigh Brackett. "Shut up!" Fury rose in Gray, hotter than the boiling springs that ran from the Sunside to water the valleys. He hated John Moulton and his daughter Jill, who had conceived this plan of building a new world for the destitute and desperate veterans of the Second Interplanetary War.

arxiv-2206-07532.title: Current state and prospects of R-packages for the design of experiments
arxiv-2206-07532.creator: Emi Tanaka, Dewi Amaliah
arxiv-2206-07532.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Emi Tanaka, Dewi Amaliah. Re-running an experiment is generally costly and, in some cases, impossible due to limited resources; therefore, the design of an experiment plays a critical role in increasing the quality of experimental data. In this paper, we describe the current state of R-packages for the design of experiments through an exploratory data analysis of package downloads, package metadata, and a comparison of characteristics with other topics.

arxiv-2212-10597.title: On the representation-free formalism in quantum theory
arxiv-2212-10597.creator: V.D. Efros
arxiv-2212-10597.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by V.D. Efros. The widespread bra-ket formalism provides efficient means to carry out representation-free considerations in quantum theory. At the same time, drawbacks are inherent in it. We discuss these drawbacks in detail, and then, construct a new representation-free scheme. The present scheme provides efficient means to facilitate representation-free considerations, similar to all those offered by the bra-ket scheme but has none of the drawbacks of the bra-ket scheme.

arxiv-2506-05476.title: Repeating Flares, X-ray Outbursts and Delayed Infrared Emission: A Comprehensive Compilation of Optical Tidal Disruption Events
arxiv-2506-05476.creator: D.A. Langis, I. Liodakis, K.I.I. Koljonen, A. Paggi, N. Globus, L. Wyrzykowski, P.J. Mikołajczyk, K. Kotysz, P. Zieliński, N. Ihanec, J. Ding, D. Morshed, Z. Torres
arxiv-2506-05476.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by D.A. Langis, I. Liodakis, K.I.I. Koljonen, A. Paggi, N. Globus, L. Wyrzykowski, P.J. Mikołajczyk, K. Kotysz, P. Zieliński, N. Ihanec, J. Ding, D. Morshed, Z. Torres. Tidal disruption events (TDEs) have been proposed as valuable laboratories for studying dormant black holes. However, progress in this field has been hampered by the limited number of observed events.

arxiv-2507-05576.title: iThermTroj: Exploiting Intermittent Thermal Trojans in Multi-Processor System-on-Chips Thanks: The work is partially supported by the National Science Foundation under grants number 2219679 and 2219680.
arxiv-2507-05576.creator: Mehdi Elahi 1 , Mohamed R. Elshamy 2 , Abdel-Hameed Badawy 2 , Ahmad Patooghy 1
arxiv-2507-05576.description: Abstract Thermal Trojan attacks present a pressing concern for the security and reliability of System-on-Chips (SoCs), especially in mobile applications. The situation becomes more complicated when such attacks are more evasive and operate sporadically to stay hidden from detection mechanisms. In this paper, we introduce Intermittent Thermal Trojans (iThermTroj) that exploit the chips’ thermal information in a random time-triggered manner.

arxiv-2512-00289.title: Data-Driven Modeling and Correction of Vehicle Dynamics
arxiv-2512-00289.creator: Nguyen Ly, Caroline Tatsuoka, Jai Nagaraj, Jacob Levy, Fernando Palafox, David Fridovich-Keil, Hannah Lu
arxiv-2512-00289.description: Abstract We develop a data-driven framework for learning and correcting non-autonomous vehicle dynamics. Physics-based vehicle models are often simplified for tractability and therefore exhibit inherent model-form uncertainty, motivating the need for data-driven correction. Moreover, non-autonomous dynamics are governed by time-dependent control inputs, which pose challenges in learning predictive models directly from temporal snapshot data.

arxiv-2512-19607.title: Nonequilibrium quantum thermometry with noncommutative system-bath couplings
arxiv-2512-19607.creator: Youssef Aiache, Abderrahim El Allati, İlkay Demir, Khadija El Anouz
arxiv-2512-19607.description: Abstract Accurate temperature estimation in the quantum and cryogenic regimes remains a fundamental challenge. Here, we investigate nonequilibrium quantum thermometry using a single-qubit probe coupled to a bosonic bath through noncommuting interaction operators, which unify pure dephasing and dissipative dynamics within a spin–boson model.

plos-pone-0001835.creator: Dick S. J. Groenenberg, Albert J. Beintema, René W. R. J. Dekker et al.
plos-pone-0001835.description: PLOS ONE research article. A persistent controversy surrounds the flightless island hen of Tristan da Cunha, Gallinula nesiotis . Some believe that it became extinct by the end of the 19th century. Others suppose that it still inhabits Tristan. There is no consensus about Gallinula comeri , the name introd

pmc-10597989.title: Effects of iguratimod on inflammatory factors and apoptosis of submandibular gland epithelial cells in NOD mice
pmc-10597989.creator: Shuying Wang, Jiake Yu, Jie Yang, Yan Ge, Jing Tian
pmc-10597989.description: Non-obese diabetic (NOD) mice were taken as primary Sjögren’s syndrome (pSS) model mice to examine the therapeutic impact of iguratimod (IGU) on inflammatory factors levels and apoptosis of submandibular epithelial cells, and provide experimental basis for the treatment of pSS by iguratimod.

pmc-10672974.title: Recent Advances in Drug Discovery for Triple-Negative Breast Cancer Treatment
pmc-10672974.creator: Domiziana Masci, Chiara Naro, Michela Puxeddu, Andrea Urbani, Claudio Sette, Giuseppe La Regina, Romano Silvestri
pmc-10672974.description: Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) is one of the most heterogeneous and aggressive breast cancer subtypes with a high risk of death on recurrence. To date, TNBC is very difficult to treat due to the lack of an effective targeted therapy.

pmc-10698093.title: Conflicting views of physicians and surgeons concerning pediatric urinary tract infection: a comparative review
pmc-10698093.creator: Ian K Hewitt, Derek J Roebuck, Giovanni Montini
pmc-10698093.description: BackgroundA first febrile urinary tract infection (UTI) is a common condition in children, and pathways of management have evolved over time.ObjectiveTo determine the extent to which pediatricians and surgeons differ in their investigation and management of a first febrile UTI, and to evaluate the justifications for any divergence of approach.

pmc-10829099.title: Effective microorganisms input efficiently improves the vegetation and microbial community of degraded alpine grassland
pmc-10829099.creator: Jinsheng Li, Juping Wei, Xinqing Shao, Xinhui Yan, Kesi Liu
pmc-10829099.description: Soil beneficial microorganism deficiency in the degraded grasslands have emerged as the major factors negatively impacting soil quality and vegetation productivity. EM (effective microorganisms) has been regarded as a good ameliorant in improving microbial communities and restoring degraded soil of agricultural systems. However, knowledge was inadequate regarding the effects of adding EM on the degraded alpine grassland.

pmc-11432519.title: To Operate or Not? Evaluating the Best Approach for First-Time Patellar Dislocations: A Review
pmc-11432519.creator: Roberto Tedeschi, Daniela Platano, Federica Giorgi, Danilo Donati
pmc-11432519.description: Background: The optimal management of first-time patellar dislocations remains a subject of debate. While surgical intervention is often recommended to reduce the risk of redislocation, the benefits over conservative treatment regarding knee function and complication rates are not clearly established.

pmc-11614562.title: Laser Aggregometry Assessment of Blood Microrheology in a Slit Fluidic Channel Covered With Endothelial Cells
pmc-11614562.creator: Alexey N. Semenov, Andrei E. Lugovtsov, Petr B. Ermolinskiy, Alexander V. Priezzhev
pmc-11614562.description: The blood rheology in vitro in glass or plastic microfluidic chips is different from that in vivo in blood vessels with similar geometry. Absence of vascular endothelium is suggested to cause these discrepancies. This work aims to perform in vitro measurements of blood microrheologic parameters in a slit microfluidic channel covered with endothelial cells (HUVEC).

pmc-11644981.title: An Improved Generative Adversarial Network-Based and U-Shaped Transformer Method for Glass Curtain Crack Deblurring Using UAVs
pmc-11644981.creator: Jiaxi Huang, Guixiong Liu, Vittorio M N Passaro
pmc-11644981.description: Drones have emerged as a critical tool for the detection of high-altitude glass curtain cracks. However, their utility is often compromised by vibrations and other environmental factors that can induce motion blur, compromising image quality and the accuracy of crack detection.

pmc-12664489.title: Epigenetic profiling reveals key super-enhancer networks driving oncogenesis in HPV-positive HNSCC
pmc-12664489.creator: Fernando T Zamuner, Spencer S Chan, Michael D Kessler, Ilya E Vorontsov, Andrey Loginov, Rossin Erbe, Eddie Imada, Deborah X Xie, Theresa Guo, Elana J Fertig, Ivan V Kulakovskiy, Ludmila Danilova, Alexander V Favorov, Daria A Gaykalova
pmc-12664489.description: SummaryHuman papillomavirus-positive (HPV+) head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) is a growing subset of cancer cases distinct from HPV-negative by fewer genetic mutations and prevalent epigenetic dysregulation. We mapped H3K27ac-marked super-enhancers (SEs) via ChIP-seq in HPV+ patient-derived xenografts (PDXs) and normal oropharyngeal mucosa, identifying tumor-specific SE domains (T-SEDs) enriched for transcription factors (TFs) including TP63, FOSL1, and JUND.

pmc-12714104.title: Carbon Dioxide Laser Ablation for the Treatment of a Rare Case of Acquired Lymphangioma Circumscriptum of the Vulva in an Adult Patient
pmc-12714104.creator: Harriet Rothschild, Sara McKinney
pmc-12714104.description: Lymphangioma circumscriptum is a rare condition that usually affects the mouth mucosa, tongue, axilla, groin, and proximal arms and legs. Vulvar involvement is uncommon and understudied, with no standardized treatment guidelines available. Lymphangioma circumscriptum is characterized by benign dilation of lymphatic channels in the skin and subcutaneous tissues, resulting in weeping and painful vesicular‐appearing growths.

pmc-12967364.title: Immune checkpoint inhibitor-based first-line therapies for advanced or unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma: a network meta-analysis and cost-effectiveness analysis
pmc-12967364.creator: Huijie Qi, Yuxin Huang, Wenxin Zhang, Jiyifan Li, Tianxiao Wang, Yinqing Ying, Bicui Chen, Feng Miao, Qunyi Li
pmc-12967364.description: Background:Immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) have transformed the treatment landscape of advanced or unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). However, the comparative clinical efficacy and cost-effectiveness of various ICI-based combination therapies remain unclear.Objectives:This study aimed to evaluate the cost-effectiveness and clinical efficacy of the 12 first-line ICI-based therapies for advanced or unresectable HCC under two distinct healthcare systems—China and the United States.

pmc-13331175.title: Prevalence of chameleons in patients with ischemic stroke: A cross-sectional study
pmc-13331175.creator: Nury Tatiana Rincón Cuenca, Andrés Felipe Herrera Ortiz, Miguel Angel Ruiz, Laura María Camargo, Cesar Alejandro Luzardo Neira, Luisa Fernanda Velasquez Bejarano, Angie Melissa Montoya Caro, Santiago Andrés Monroy Santos, Jaime Eduardo Rodriguez, Carlos Fernando Martinez

pmc-13361408.title: Beyond Compliance: An HRO-Based Governance Framework for ISO 45001–Enabled Safety Strategy in Healthcare
pmc-13361408.creator: Bandar Saad Alshreef
pmc-13361408.description: PurposeThis paper proposes a conceptual framework to reposition the ISO 45001 standard from a compliance-driven tool to a strategic governance framework for improving occupational health and safety (OHS) in healthcare.Design/Methodology/ApproachThis is a conceptual paper that synthesizes existing literature from management, safety science, and healthcare.

pmc-13398884.title: Clarity Without Credibility? Human Versus AI Abstracts in Otolaryngology
pmc-13398884.creator: Sholem Hack, Rebecca Attal, Lirit Levi, David T. Liu, Mahdokht Manavi, Luca Giovanni Locatello, Maxime Fieux, Evan M. de Joya, Joel M. Gutovitz, Shahar Eliahu, Tal Hefetz, Tomer Boldes, Ameen Biadsee
pmc-13398884.description: ObjectiveThis study evaluated whether otolaryngologists can distinguish between human‐ and machine‐written abstracts. The primary question was whether large language models (LLMs) produce abstracts comparable in clarity and usefulness to human‐authored work, and whether reviewers can identify authorship with accuracy.MethodsA blinded cross‐sectional design was used. Forty‐eight abstracts were evaluated, consisting of twenty‐four human‐authored abstracts and 24 generated by four LLMs.

pmc-13576626.title: Norethisterone‐Associated Decidual Cast Expulsion Mimicking an Acute Gynecologic Emergency: A Case Report
pmc-13576626.creator: Tuka Hamasho, Nazaha Al‐hassoun, Nagham Al‐hassoun, Mohammad Al Diab Al Azzawi, Hiba Abdullah, Walid al saleh
pmc-13576626.description: Decidual cast is a rare benign condition that may mimic acute gynecologic emergencies. It should be suspected in patients with severe colicky pain followed by sudden relief after tissue expulsion, especially with progestin use such as norethisterone. Accurate diagnosis and histopathology prevent unnecessary surgery.
